# contemplative-agent-mlx

> Optional local MLX generation backend for
> [contemplative-agent](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent).
> On Apple Silicon, installing it and running the `contemplative-agent-mlx`
> entry point routes generation (distill, insight, rules-distill,
> amend-constitution, post, comment, reply, dialogue) through a local
> `mlx_lm.server` (Apple MLX runtime) instead of Ollama — ~1.8× faster and
> ~3.4 GB lighter on the same Qwen3.5 9B weights. Embeddings continue to use
> local `nomic-embed-text` via Ollama.
>
> This is a local-runtime swap, not a cloud backend: everything stays
> on-device, so the main repository's "No cloud, no API keys in transit"
> property is preserved. It mirrors the `contemplative-agent-cloud` add-on's
> Protocol-injection shape without the cloud-egress trade-off.
>
> Intended for interactive / manual / short-lived runs only. On a 16 GB host
> `mlx_lm.server` is unfit for the unattended scheduled agent (see ADR-0067),
> which is why the main repository's production schedule runs on Ollama.

## Core documentation

- [README](README.md): requirements, install, configure, run, security posture, unattended-use caveat
- Main project README: [contemplative-agent README](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent/blob/main/README.md)

## Configuration

- **`MLX_BASE_URL`** — mlx_lm.server origin (default `http://localhost:8080`), restricted to localhost / `OLLAMA_TRUSTED_HOSTS`
- **`MLX_MODEL`** — served model id (default `mlx-community/Qwen3.5-9B-4bit`)

## Architecture

- `src/contemplative_agent_mlx/backends/mlx.py`: `MlxLmBackend` — implements the `LLMBackend` Protocol against a local `mlx_lm.server` over its OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions` shape. Sends `top_p`/`top_k` for sampler parity with the Ollama path (Qwen3.5 degenerates into repetition loops at high temperature otherwise). A `format` schema is rendered into a prompt instruction (the server has no native structured-output mode). Declares `context_window=32768` — memory-bounded on the 16 GB host, not Qwen3.5-9B's 262k native window.
- `src/contemplative_agent_mlx/cli.py`: wrapper entry point. Reads `MLX_BASE_URL` / `MLX_MODEL` from the environment, constructs `MlxLmBackend`, calls `contemplative_agent.core.llm.configure(backend=...)`, then delegates to the main `contemplative-agent` CLI. Never launches the server.
- `scripts/serve-mlx.sh`: start a local `mlx_lm.server` (via `uvx --from mlx-lm`) with `--prompt-cache-size 2` and thinking off.
- `scripts/run-with-mlx.sh`: on-demand lifecycle — start the server, wait for health, run `contemplative-agent-mlx`, stop the server on exit. mlx-lm is NOT a Python dependency (the backend only speaks HTTP).

## Security / operational trade-off

This add-on does **not** relax the "No cloud" property — generation stays
local (a second `localhost` port served by MLX), reusing the same SSRF guard
and output sanitizer as the Ollama path. The trade-off is operational:
`mlx_lm.server` is unfit for unattended continuous use on 16 GB (EOS runaway,
OOM → circuit cascade, prefill cliff, prompt-cache churn, wired-memory
thrash). Use it for interactive / manual / short-lived runs; run the main
repository on Ollama for the unattended schedule.

## Related repositories

- [contemplative-agent](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent): the main repository that this package extends
- [contemplative-agent-cloud](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent-cloud): the sibling managed-LLM (cloud) add-on, same Protocol-injection shape
